1.5.8.scope: Initial provider, per-session launch files, hook/title turn signals and exact-path folder trust (T-1225).

claims.claim: Hooks load from .agents/hooks.json in a folder added with --add-dir, and .agents/mcp_config.json beside it starts its server, leaving the checkout and ~/.gemini untouched.
--settings is session-only (trustedWorkspaces, title command, permissions.allow, agentMode) and never saved back to ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/settings.json.
On PreToolUse, printing {} or {"decision":""} denies the tool call and a non-zero exit blocks it; zero bytes on stdout is no opinion.
agy starts a background update check at every interactive launch.

1.5.9.scope: Brief and MCP tools (T-1232), composer paste/steer/Esc (T-1233), modes and model list (T-1234, T-1326), transcript/cost/context/quota (T-1237), and subagent hold (T-1332).

brief_get_ticket.claim: Title-only prompt receives SessionStart brief, rejects server/discover (-32601) before initialize (2025-11-25), calls get_ticket first and replies with the description nonce.

claims.claim: Esc mid-turn emits no Stop; the title feed transitioning to idle without a prior Stop or running background work identifies the interrupt.

Hooks supply brain/<id>/.system_generated/logs/transcript_full.jsonl with uncached input_tokens, cache_read_tokens and output_tokens; the title feed's antigravity/brain path is not written by the CLI.
Child subagents inherit the seat's hooks with their own conversationId; Stop with fullyIdle=false and title subagents/task_count hold the seat working until the lead stops and background work drains.

1.5.13.scope: Lead transcript repair and rapid-resume settle (T-1334), worktree trust checkout hint (T-1361), interactive MCP startup ordering (T-1380), and PreToolUse write gate, session-folder boundary, presence lock and compaction inspection (T-1238).

claims.claim: Cascade models issue write_to_file, replace_file_content and multi_replace_file_content (TargetFile), sed_file (target_file) and notebook_edit (NotebookPath/notebook_path/AbsolutePathUri), while direct-tool models such as Gemini 4 Carbon issue write_file and edit_file (Path); mesimon gate --provider agy matches and judges both sets.

PreToolUse runs inside HookMixinWrapper tool conversion (PreToolHookConverter) ahead of permission confirmation, so --dangerously-skip-permissions auto-approves confirmation prompts without skipping hooks or overriding a PreToolUse deny.

--add-dir mounts <state>/agy/<session> in agy's Active Workspaces; mesimon gate --allow exempts only <state>/worktrees, denying structured writes to <state>/agy/<session>/.agents/hooks.json and <state>/agy/<session>.json under StateDir while run_command stays unhooked.

presence/<conversation>.lock under ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli is an empty BSD flock(LOCK_EX | LOCK_NB) file carrying no PID; probing it acquires the exclusive lock and touches ~/.gemini, while agy natively refuses a duplicate --conversation writer at startup.
Interactive sessions start MCP servers in the background (since 1.1.9), so the first turn can precede eager tool registration even when .agents/mcp_config.json marks get_ticket eager.

In a Mesimon git worktree, .git points into the main checkout's .git/worktrees/<branch>, which agy's default command sandbox blocks (git exits 128) unless the main checkout is accessible or the command runs outside the sandbox.
agy exposes no PreCompact or PostCompact hook in hooks.json; automatic compaction runs inside an active turn and manual /compact emits no Stop (settling without EndTurn/REVIEW movement).
